title: Feasibility screen before a comparative research-process pilot

stages.name: feasibility_screen
stages.purpose: Determine whether withheld-outcome energy decisions can be scored reliably without contamination.

stages.name: comparative_pilot
stages.purpose: Screen for a useful process advantage; not powered evidence of general calibration or universal superiority.

comparators: Competent single model selected on separate development cases
Unstructured group with the same composition and tools as the structured group
missing_reason: These design choices require case curation and practitioner review before registration. No study has run.
decision_rules: Invalid scoring or contaminated cases require revising the task, not declaring the protocol falsified.
A meaningful loss or failure to meet a prespecified useful-effect rule counts against this implementation within tested conditions.
An imprecise or nonsignificant result can remain unresolved.
A promising pilot earns prospective independent testing, not a general success claim.
